message.reasoning:
Grid squares 2cm each. Plate: full rectangle 12×9 squares minus notch (upper-right: x 8–12, y 5–9, 4×4 squares) minus two holes.

Total squares: 12×9=108, notch 4×4=16 → 92. Holes: void1 x5–7,y6–8 = 2×2=4 squares; void2 x2–4,y2–4 = 2×2=4 squares. Material = 92−8 = 84 squares = 84×4 = 336 cm².

Boundary: outer boundary length. Outer perimeter of 12×9 rectangle = 2(12+9)=42 squares. Notch removes top edge from x8 to 12 (4) and right edge from y5 to 9 (4), adds notch edges: vertical at x=8 from y5 to 9 (4) and horizontal at y=5 from x8 to 12 (4). So outer = 42 squares = 84 cm.

Holes: each 2×2 square hole perimeter = 8 squares = 16 cm. Two holes = 32 cm.

Total boundary = 84+32 = 116 cm. Hole count = 2.
